{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Americans have been promised change before and too often have been disappointed.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A commitment to change not just policies, but politics as well.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group cannot expect different results by doing the same things.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A commitment to renew American democracy by promoting the use of new technologies to make it easier for Americans to participate in their government.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A commitment to shine a light on government spending and Washington lobbying so that every American is empowered to be a watchdog and a whistleblower.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group is the party of inclusion and respect for differences of perspective and belief.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Even when disagreeing, the group will work together to move the country forward.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There can be no Republican or Democratic ideas, only policies that are smart, right, fair, and good for America, and those that aren't.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A commitment to form a government as decent, candid, purposeful, and compassionate as the American people themselves.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Being a patriot means declaring and showing love for the nation through deeds, priorities, and commitments.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
